title: Electricity generating capacity
source: US Energy Information Administration, International Energy Statistics
definition: Total electricity generating capacity reported by EIA (electricity product 2, capacity activity 7). Million kilowatts converted to MW by multiplying by 1,000. Capacity is potential power, not annual generation or electricity consumed. No inference of dependable capacity or power available to data centres.
revision_note: One EIA data vintage. Historical estimates may be revised; source flags retained. National boundaries and coverage may change. No interpolation.
